changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6625-retire-fieldmeta-decimals.md`

- names `GridField.tsx` → `packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `buildFieldMeta` computed `decimals: overrides.decimals ?? meta?.decimals ?? meta?.scale` on **every** call and the value **reached nothing**. Re-measured on this branch's base (`efdc6c62`): **zero `.decimals` member reads** across `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/core` and `plugin-dashboard` itself — the only non-comment occurrence was the write being removed here. The **positive control in the same query shape** fires: `.scale` member reads hit `NumberField.tsx`, `GridField.tsx` and `fields/src/index.tsx`. So the zero is a finding, not a broken query. The `overrides.decimals ??` head of that chain had already lost its only feeder when objectui#6425's ruling removed the authored read from `ObjectDataTable.enrich()`; `RecordDetailDrawer`, the only other `buildFieldMeta` caller, passes no overrides at all. Both halves retire together, so the key leaves in one move.

### `.changeset/6661-app-launcher-nav-menu-renderers.md`

- names `en.ts` → `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` — edited by this change

  > Three new strings — the launcher's and the menu's accessible names, and the menu's empty state — are declared under `console.nav` in `en.ts` and its nine sibling packs. An inline `defaultValue` alone is not a fix: it renders English at one call site and leaves the string untranslatable everywhere (objectui#3517).

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `84b275c01` (merge-base with origin/main): 17 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1766 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2372 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36627221856)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `370aaf443050835b9c8fc5f49151f512ac687d02`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card objectui#11131 (body, triage `5896632949`, claim `5897282582`, os-dev-report `5898356660`), PR objectui#11143 (body, 18-file list, net diff against `main`), the head's check-runs (`filter=latest`), and context reads of `LineItemsPanel.tsx`, `GridField.tsx`, `MasterDetailForm.tsx`, `formChrome.ts`, `useFieldTranslation.ts`, `useSafeTranslation.ts`, `fallbackInterpolation.ts`, `en.ts`, `zh.ts`, `check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`, `ci.yml`, `.changeset/config.json` at the head via `contents/PATH?ref=SHA`. Nothing built, run or re-run.

**Gates on the head.** Runs were still in progress when this review began; the poll waited until every run had completed (the last at about 2026-09-29T20:49Z) before judging. All 43 check-runs on `370aaf443` are completed: 40 `success`, 3 `skipped` (`Test (coverage)`, the coverage shard matrix and `dependabot`, none of which runs on a PR head), 0 failed. The successes include `Type Check` (the job that also runs `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` and `check:i18n-designer-parity`), `Lint`, `Test` shards 1–8 (the four new pin files, the bumped de census and `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack` live there), `Test (dist pins)`, `Build & E2E`, `Build Docs`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Changeset Overwrite Report`, `Control Byte Scan`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `Spec Main Shape Gate`. `check:i18n-dead-keys` has no CI job (a report-only sweep, per `ci.yml`); each of the four new keys is read by a call site in this diff.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set: nothing moves. No schema, prop, type, zod arm or accepted value changes; the diff touches two components' default strings, ten locale packs, one census pin, four new pin files and one changeset. Public surface: four new pack keys appear in `@object-ui/i18n` (additive), and the fields / plugin-form components read them. Every judgment below is named.

1. **New keys, four, in all ten packs, holes kept, en byte-equal — right.** `form.lineItems.title` = `Line Items`, `fields.grid.addLine` = `Add line`, `fields.grid.noItems` = `No items`, `fields.grid.noItemsAddHint` = `No items yet — click “{{label}}” to begin.` Each `en` value is byte-equal to the literal it replaces at the base (`schema.title || 'Line Items'`, `cfg.add_label || 'Add line'`, the JSX text `No items`, and `No items yet — click “{cfg.add_label || 'Add'}” to begin.` whose hole is now `add_label || detail.add`, `detail.add` being `Add`). ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh each add the same four keys under the same paths (`form.lineItems`, `fields.grid`), each `noItemsAddHint` keeps the `{{label}}` hole with locale-native quotes. None of the four had an existing same-meaning key: the `en` pack at the head holds no other `Line Items` value (`form.masterDetail.lineItem` is the singular `Line item`), no `Add line` (`detail.add` is `Add`, so reusing it would have changed the English), and `No items` only as `appDesigner.navNoPreviewItems`, which belongs to the app designer's nav preview and is translated for it (zh `无项目`, not the grid's `暂无条目`), while `list.noItems` is `No items found`. Adding rather than reusing is what the triage's "only where none means the same thing" permits.
2. **Reused keys — right, each the same meaning.** `common.save` (`Save` / zh `保存`) for the idle button; `detail.saving` (`Saving…` / zh `保存中…`) for the in-flight button, the key `MasterDetailForm` already reads for its own in-flight Save; `detail.add` (`Add` / zh `添加`) for the empty text's hole when no `add_label` is authored, the literal `'Add'` it replaces. All three sit under the blocks their names say (`common`, `detail`) at the head.
3. **Hook choice: the panel extends its own `useLineItemsTranslation` rather than `useFormChromeTranslation` — honours the triage in substance, not a breach.** The triage's direction is "the objectui#11071 pattern, reusing existing keys"; the card's own direction wrote it as "`createSafeTranslation` / `useFormChromeTranslation` in `plugin-form`", and the claim on the card allowed either the panel's table or `useFormChromeTranslation`. The pattern's contract is: pack lookup under a provider, a `createSafeTranslation` table held byte-equal to `en` for the provider-less path, and existing keys reused. The panel's hook is exactly such a table (`check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` holds every `createSafeTranslation` row to `en`, objectui#7567), `formChrome.ts` itself states the precedent that a component owning its own hook carries its own rows (WizardForm / DrawerForm / ModalForm) and accepts the resulting duplicate rows because the gate keeps them from drifting, and `formChrome.ts` was outside the claim's file surface. The observable result — zh renders of title and both button states, English byte-identical with and without a provider, `common.save` / `detail.saving` reused — is the one the triage asked for. The cost is two more duplicated rows (`common.save`, `detail.saving`) inside one package; the dev named the mechanical switch if the seat wants the name honoured literally. Flagged in the report and the PR, not settled silently. Right.
4. **`GridField` serving English through inline `defaultValue`s gated by `check:i18n-keys` rather than `FIELD_DEFAULTS` rows — right.** `createSafeTranslation`'s provider-less path resolves `defaults[key] || inline defaultValue || key` and interpolates through `interpolateFallback` (`{{label}}` filled, `defaultValue` skipped), so the three inline defaults render byte-identical English with no provider, including the hole (the `.no-provider` pin asserts `No items yet — click “New row” to begin.`). Under a provider i18next answers from the pack. `check:i18n-keys` holds each inline default to its `en` value (default-value-drift) and its arguments to the `en` holes (interpolation-parity), and that gate runs in the `Type Check` job on this head. `useFieldTranslation.ts` was outside the declared surface; a table row would have been equivalent, not better. Right.
5. **de census pin bump (`de-quote-pairing-3876`, 68 → 69, 68/68/0 → 69/69/0) — right, outside the surface by necessity.** The de `noItemsAddHint` value `Noch keine Einträge – klicken Sie auf „{{label}}“, um zu beginnen.` adds exactly one matched „…“ pair; the other three de rows carry no quotes. An absolute census must move by one, the file's own convention is a bump with a comment naming the key (the same comments record objectui#7699 and objectui#11000), and the comment is there. Forced by the diff, not a choice.
6. **English byte-identical with and without a provider — right.** Provider-less: the panel's table rows and the grid's inline defaults are the old literals byte for byte (`Line Items`, `Save`, `Saving…`, `Add line`, `No items`, `No items yet — click “Add” to begin.`), pinned by the two `.no-provider` files. With a provider: the `en` pack carries the same bytes (`check:i18n-drift`: 4 keys added, 0 `en` values changed). Authored `title` / `add_label` still win at every site (`schema.title || t(...)`, `cfg.add_label || t(...)`, and `label: cfg.add_label || t('detail.add')`), pinned by both CONTROL cases.
7. **Pins match the card's list — right.** Panel: zh title `明细行`, idle `保存`, in-flight `保存中…` (through a held `batchTransaction`), the grid's `添加行`, a read-only panel's `暂无条目`, CONTROL authored `title`. Grid: zh `添加行`, list-mode `暂无条目，点击“添加”开始添加。`, read-only `暂无条目`, CONTROL authored `add_label` as both the button and the hole. `t` is in scope at both panel sites (line 182 inside `LineItemsPanel`, which spans 180–781 at the head).

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` — confirmed. The changeset `.changeset/11131-line-items-chrome.md` declares `@object-ui/fields: patch`, `@object-ui/i18n: patch`, `@object-ui/plugin-form: patch`. Those are the three released packages the diff touches (`check-changeset-presence`: 17 source files of 3 released packages, 1 changeset), all three sit in the one fixed group in `.changeset/config.json`, and patch is the level this family used for the same shape of change (`11039-form-chrome-i18n.md`, `11071-form-chrome-remainder.md`: pack keys added, defaults moved, patch). No accept-set, type, prop or schema moves, so no minor is owed. The changeset's claims (four new keys, three reused, defaults only, en byte-identical) match the diff. Changeset Declaration, Fixed Group, Bump Policy, Claim Re-read and Overwrite Report all passed on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: none declared. Deviations, each answered:

- Hook choice (`useLineItemsTranslation` not `useFormChromeTranslation`): honours the direction in substance, judged at ① 3. No escalation needed; if the seat wants the triage's name honoured literally, the dev's stated switch is a follow-up, not a blocker.
- `GridField` inline defaults instead of `FIELD_DEFAULTS` rows: judged at ① 4, right.
- `de-quote-pairing-3876` outside the surface: judged at ① 5, forced by the diff, right.
- Commit trailers and PR footer in the repo's model-free form rather than the harness reminder's: the repo's AGENTS.md form governs in this repo; not a contract matter.
- The un-narrowed whole-package run at `8cf648cfe` holding the lock 15m37s: a process note, no bearing on the head.

Out-of-scope notes, each answered at the head:

1. **The rest of `LineItemsPanel` / `GridField` chrome still English under zh — real at the head, same family.** Read at `370aaf443`: `LineItemsPanel.tsx` still carries `Loading…` (line 747), `Save the record first to add line items.` (750), `This record’s line items have not been loaded.` (762), the `Failed to load line items` / `Failed to save line items` fallbacks (528, 661) and the no-child-object hint (743). `GridField.tsx` still carries `Columns` (872), `Optional columns` (881), `Total` (991, 1407), `Computed` (1074) and the row-action `aria-label` / `title` pairs `Drag to reorder` (1292–1293), `Open row` / `Open full form` (1350–1351), `Duplicate row` / `Duplicate line` (1368–1369), `Remove row` (1384). The dev's zh probe measured `Save the record first to add line items.` and the `Total` footer as public-door reach. Same family (form chrome left English under zh, objectui#10999 → #11039 → #11071 → #11131). The card named its sites, so leaving these was correct, and the disagreeing aria/title pairs make the key choice non-mechanical.
2. **`MasterDetailForm`'s section heading `{d.title || 'Line Items'}` — real at the head.** Line 634 of `MasterDetailForm.tsx` at `370aaf443`, inside the component whose `t` is `useFormChromeTranslation` (line 566).
